title: 第一卷 第26章 落霞秘境第一卷 第25章 狭路相逢
slug: 百倍返还我家孽徒全是女帝转世
content_zh:
大批赤霞宗弟子簇拥着锦衣华服的燕宸，堵死了山谷出口。
燕宸居高临下扫过倒地哀嚎的三名散修，又看向风姿卓绝的赤瑶，嘴角勾起一抹讥讽。
“倒是有点本事，区区低阶修士，也能拿下三枚筑基散修。”
他目光扫过林枫，语气极尽倨傲：“我再给你最后一次机会，让你徒儿拜入我赤霞宗，跟着我修行。”
“留在这废物师尊身边，一辈子也就只能捡捡秘境边角料，难成大器。”
这话极尽嘲讽，摆明了要当众羞辱林枫，抢夺他的徒弟。
赤霞宗一众弟子纷纷哄笑，眼神戏谑地打量着林枫师徒。
“少宗主仁厚，还愿意给他们机会！”
“可惜啊，跟着一个无名散修，纯属浪费天赋！”
“我看这白衣修士就是个普通散修，怕是连金丹境都摸不到！”
嘈杂的嘲讽声刺耳至极。
王肖瞬间怒了，上前一步就要理论，却被林枫抬手拦下。
林枫抬眸，神色平淡，不见半分怒意，只淡淡开口：“我的徒弟，轮不到外人置喙。”
“燕少宗主管好自己的人，别没事找事，自取其辱。”
“自取其辱？”
燕宸像是听到了天大的笑话，金丹四层威压轰然铺开，狠狠朝着几人碾压而来！
“一个连宗门底蕴都没有的散修，也敢跟我这么说话？”
“今日我便让你看清差距！要么把这红衣师妹交出来随我走，要么，你们今日全部留在这山谷！”
金丹威压恐怖绝伦，压得周遭草木弯折，空气都变得凝重窒息。
王肖瞬间脸色发白，柳雨姝和赤瑶也眉头紧蹙，下意识挡在林枫身前。

她们修为尚浅，根本扛不住金丹修士的威压。
看着挺身而出、护着自己的两个徒弟，林枫眼底寒意骤起。
十年蛰伏，人人都当他是废人，人人都敢踩他一脚、辱他师徒！
今日，也该让东域这些宗门，重新认识一下他林枫！
“护住自身，看为师出手。”
林枫轻声叮嘱一句，缓步踏出。
一身紫金镇罡袍悄然隐现，周身看似毫无灵力波动，却硬生生将燕宸的金丹威压隔绝在外，纹丝不动。
在所有人惊愕的目光中，他抬手拔剑。
嗤——
清霜出鞘，霜气漫天！
凛冽刺骨的剑道威压瞬间席卷整座山谷，硬生生压盖燕宸的金丹气势！
content_en:
A large number of Chixia Sect disciples surrounded Yan Chen, who was dressed in brilliant clothes, and blocked the exit of the valley.
Yan Chen looked down from a high position and glanced at the three casual cultivators who were lying on the ground wailing, and then looked at the elegant Chi Yao, with a hint of sarcasm on his lips.
"He is quite capable. A mere low-level monk can also win three foundation-building casual cultivators."
He glanced at Lin Feng and said in an extremely arrogant tone: "I will give you one last chance to let your disciple join my Chixia Sect and practice with me."
"If you stay with this useless master, you will only be able to pick up scraps from the secret realm for the rest of your life, and it will be difficult to become something great."
These words were extremely sarcastic and made it clear that he wanted to humiliate Lin Feng in public and steal his apprentice.
All the disciples of Chixia Sect burst into laughter and looked at Master and Disciple Lin Feng teasingly.
"Young Sect Master is kind and willing to give them a chance!"
"What a pity. Following an unknown cultivator is a waste of talent!"
"I think this monk in white is just an ordinary cultivator. I'm afraid he can't even touch the golden elixir realm!"
The cacophony of jeers was harsh.
Wang Xiao became angry instantly and took a step forward to argue, but Lin Feng raised his hand to stop him.
Lin Feng raised his eyes, his expression was calm, there was no hint of anger, he just said calmly: "My apprentice, it is not the turn of outsiders to comment."
"Yan Shaozong takes care of his own people. Don't look for trouble and bring shame on yourself."
"Insulting yourself?"
Yan Chen seemed to have heard a big joke, and the four levels of Jindan's pressure suddenly spread out, crushing towards several people!
"A casual cultivator who doesn't even have any sect knowledge dares to talk to me like that?"
"Today I will let you see the difference clearly! Either hand over this junior sister in red and let me go, or you all stay in this valley today!"
The pressure of the golden elixir was terrifying, causing the surrounding vegetation to bend and the air to become heavy and suffocating.
Wang Xiao's face instantly turned pale, and Liu Yushu and Chi Yao also frowned and subconsciously stood in front of Lin Feng.
Their cultivation is still shallow and they cannot withstand the pressure of the Golden Core cultivators.
Looking at the two disciples who stepped forward to protect him, Lin Feng's eyes suddenly became cold.
After ten years of dormancy, everyone regarded him as a useless person, and everyone dared to step on him and humiliate him as master and disciple!
Today, it is time for these sects in the Eastern Region to get to know Lin Feng again!
"Protect yourself and wait until your master takes action."
Lin Feng whispered a warning and stepped out slowly.
A purple-gold Zhengang robe appeared quietly. There seemed to be no spiritual energy fluctuations around his body, but he blocked Yan Chen's golden elixir pressure from the outside and remained motionless.
Under everyone's shocked eyes, he raised his hand and drew his sword.
Chi——
The clear frost is out of its sheath, and the frost is filling the sky!
The biting sword pressure swept across the entire valley in an instant, overwhelming Yan Chen's golden elixir momentum!
